learning_goal: Establish rigorous principles of confidence intervals, point estimation, margin of error, and sample size calculations to discipline statistical inference and evaluation reporting in vault procedures.
expected_capabilities: Construct and interpret confidence intervals for a single population mean when population standard deviation is known using normal distribution and z-scores.
Construct and interpret confidence intervals for a single population mean when population standard deviation is unknown using Student's t-distribution and degrees of freedom.
Construct and interpret confidence intervals for a population proportion using standard normal approximations and the plus-four method.
Calculate minimum sample size required to estimate a population mean or proportion within a specified margin of error at a given confidence level.
Distinguish between point estimates and interval estimates, correctly interpreting the confidence level as the long-run capture proportion of repeated samples.
Enforce the fundamental requirement of independent observations to prevent pseudoreplication and sample size inflation.
forbidden_outputs: Promotion of proposed notes to ACTIVE without explicit human attestation
Reporting of sample proportions without explicit sample size N and confidence intervals
Fabricated statistical definitions or unverified formulas absent from chapter text
